name: tokencard
description: Turn your local AI coding agent logs into an embeddable stat card.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tokencard/core && npm run build -w @tokencard/cli && npm run build -w tokencard-site
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @tokencard/cli && npm run test -w @tokencard/core && npm run test -w @tokencard/cli
scripts.db:reset: podman compose -f compose.yaml down -v && podman compose -f compose.yaml up -d
scripts.db:psql: podman exec -it tokencard-db psql -U tokencard -d tokencard
